_description: Phase 7 capability fixture: multiple stacked/layered transmissive glass surfaces (3 glass panes in a row plus a glass cube) -- exercises the auto-escalated bounce settings (max_bounces/transmission_bounces/transparent_max_bounces -> 24, blur_glossy -> 1.0) triggered by normalize_scene detecting material.transmission > 0 anywhere in the scene. Without this escalation, light passing through several glass surfaces runs out of Blender's default 12 bounces and renders black past the 12th surface -- confirmed this does NOT happen here even with 4 transmissive objects in the camera's view path. Also exercises the auto-SOLIDIFY on the PLANE panes (a zero-thickness plane can't properly refract).
